title: 911 Dispatcher: Unknown Caller
description: NOTE: THIS VERSION OF GAME IS DESIGNED ONLY FOR APPLE DEVICES WITH 2048x1536 SCREEN RESOLUTION (REQUIRE iPad 3 or later) !!!  FREE FOR A LIMITED TIME!  Use cannon balls and timer bombs to eliminate all Monsters. Hit, smash, explode or fire them up - it's your choice. Expend your ammunition sparingly to achieve best scores and 3 stars.  Have you played physics games before? We know it will not be too hard for you to complete all 30 levels (2 stages), but do you have what it takes to collect 3 stars on all of them? You will enjoy the amazing graphics,  relaxing music and intense enviroment sounds.  Simple cannon balls will help you to crash construction, timer-based bombs will allow you to reach inaccessible places. Different obstacles like barrels, TNT-boxes or bonfires will help you and complicate tasks at same time.  Get ready to Master the Cannon !
